scope: Implement and verify the bounded 7AP.3 generic DXF typed proxy-graphics replay path, retaining default compatibility behavior and the existing fast validation cadence.

method.kind: Local source implementation plus generated in-memory ASCII/Binary DXF vectors and wire/readback assertions
method.limitations: Only representative AC1021/group-92 and AC1024/group-160 caller-authored payloads were emitted in generated ASCII/Binary vectors. This does not qualify every DXF version/entity carrier, parsed-cache emission, DWG proxy streams, unknown/resource-dependent opcodes, independent producers, rendering, or native application behavior. DRW_Entity layout changed; downstream binaries must be rebuilt.

behavior.observed: The generic entity writer requires explicit replay authorization, positive exact current and declared byte count under the existing cap, exact source/target DXF version, exact source/output codepage, and the target-era group count. Only parsed ASCII/Binary DXF or caller-supplied provenance is accepted; DWG-origin data is refused.

Complete recognized primitive streams emit once in common entity scope with group 92 before AC1024 or group 160 at AC1024+, using the existing 127-byte group-310 chunk boundary. Caller data/count are unchanged.

ASCII/Binary AC1021 and AC1024 vectors cover 0, 127, 128, 255, and 256 bytes, exact declared count and chunk lengths/contents, readback provenance, and a following LINE sentinel. Strict refusals cover wrong target version, wrong codepage, stale count, and indexed-resource stream.

openWork: parsed-cache emission through a bounded source-authenticated profile
additional version/entity-specific replay matrices where relevant
independent producer and consumer semantic evidence at the existing composed gate
